sloka: स तम् पितृ सखम् मत्वा पूजयामास राघवः ।स तस्य कुलम् अव्यग्रम् अथ पप्रच्छ नाम च ॥३-१४-४॥
transliteration: sa tam pitṛ sakham matvā pūjayāmāsa rāghavaḥ ।sa tasya kulam avyagram atha papraccha nāma ca ॥3-14-4॥

translations.english: Rama knew he was a friend of his father. So he enquired in a cool, composed voice his name and his lineage.
